mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% y/y, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a lower unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6.0) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is between 5.5% and 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a rapidly strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market that stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
